altbuild: none: pip-wrapped Python package, one pinned wheel image.

comparison.rule: Every one of the six lowest sorted eigenvalues of the lifted operator is graded pointwise, |c-r|<=atol+rtol|r|; nothing excluded.

configuration: spin_basis_1d(L=10, kblock=0, pblock=1); H1=zz(J1)+x(h)+z(g) lifted to the full 2^L Hilbert space via project_op; six lowest eigenvalues of the lifted operator.
default_vs_upstream: L shrunk from 12 to 10 to keep the lifted 2^L=1024 dimensional operator's partial diagonalisation cheap; upstream's own printed quantity (symmetry-reduced vs full Hilbert-space dimension) is a count and is excluded, replaced by the lifted operator's low spectrum.

evidence.floor_how: no alternative build; the nominal/variant self-validation measures the spread

observable: projected_low_spectrum: the six lowest sorted eigenvalues of H1 lifted onto the full Hilbert space by project_op.
variant: the longitudinal-x field h changes from h=0.8945 to h*(1+1e-13) (relative 1e-13); h multiplies the on-site "x" operator, the only off-diagonal term shared by H1 and H2, so perturbing it moves every eigenvector and every downstream quantity computed from H1 or H2; the model conserves no U(1) once the x-field is present (unlike ed-spin's fixed-Nup XXZ chain), so g and J are not pure-identity-shift alternatives here either, but h is kept as the one active parameter for consistency across this family.
warrant: A wrong projector, basis mapping or eigensolver changes the lifted operator's low spectrum far beyond the measured bound; a correct but differently-ordered summation stays inside it -- the active-h variant supplies the calibration evidence.
